questions.prompt: What is the single most important goal of today's session?
options: That every student feels they are in the right place and belongs
That students memorise the college handbook
That students complete a written test
That students choose their optional units
questions.explanation: The session's top priority is belonging — content is secondary to every student leaving feeling they're in the right place.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Year 2?
What is identified as the biggest Year 2 risk?
Which of these is NOT one of the four parts of your study programme?
questions.explanation: The four parts are your qualification, English & maths, work-related learning, and tutorial & personal development. Clubs sit under Enrichment, not the study programme.

questions.prompt: Complete how Pro Portal is described.
Why should you continue using support services?
Which of these is one of the four support services mentioned?
questions.explanation: The four support services are learning support, wellbeing & mental health, money & practical help, and careers & next steps.

questions.prompt: What does the session say you should do if something isn't working for you?
options: Tell us early so it can be sorted
Wait until the end of the year
Say nothing and hope it improves
questions.explanation: Teachers ask students to tell them early if something isn't working, rather than staying quiet.
